## Self-review (Claude Code, autonomous) — branch diff vs `main`

**What the diff does:** routes the four B/I/U/S toggles (action *and* `pressed`
state) in the shared `TextFormatGroup`, plus the B/I/U trio in the docs
header/footer slim toolbar, from `getSelectionStyle()` (one caret sample) to
`getRangeStyleSummary()` (range-aware), via a new `isStyleOn()` helper where
`'mixed'` means "not applied → click applies".

### Correctness — verified by reading the implementations

- **Collapsed caret is unchanged.** `EditorAPI.getSelectionStyle()`
  (`editor.ts:2766`) is `getSelectionStyleImpl(true)` + pending; the summary's
  no-selection branch is the same caret walk with the same
  `styleDefaultsForBlock` layering and the same pending merge. Ditto
  `TextBoxEditorAPI` (`text-box-editor.ts:998` vs `:1017`). So the swap is a
  no-op for carets — including the named-style case (a Heading 1 that is bold
  via its style still reads `bold: true` and still un-bolds on click).
- **Both summaries normalise anchor/focus order** before walking
  (`editor.ts` context-block branch, `text-box-editor.ts` block branch), which
  is what makes the fix direction-independent.
- **The exact repro value is right.** After clearing bold from `cd`, every run
  in the range carries `bold: false` → one token → `summary.bold === false` →
  `!isStyleOn(false)` → `applyStyle({ bold: true })`. Bold comes back.
  All-unset → key omitted → `undefined` → also applies. Some set / some unset →
  `'mixed'` → applies. All three land on "apply", which is correct.
- **Header/footer is covered**, despite the summary's range branch keying off
  block indices: `Document.getBlockIndex()` searches `getContextBlocks()`, and
  the loop reads `getContextBlocks()[i]` — so a header selection resolves. I
  checked this specifically because a body-only lookup here would have made
  header B/I/U one-way.
- **Table cell ranges improve** (the summary walks the rectangle; the caret
  read did not). The one uncovered shape — anchor and focus in *different*
  cells without `tableCellRange` — visits nothing and falls through to "apply",
  which is benign and not reachable through the drag path that sets
  `tableCellRange`.
- **No other `TextFormatGroup` call site breaks.** All three real ones
  (`docs-formatting-toolbar`, slides `text-edit-section`, slides
  `mobile-toolbar`) pass a full `EditorAPI`/`TextBoxEditorAPI`. The visual
  harness stub already implements `getRangeStyleSummary()`, and it returns no
  boolean keys, so the four toggles render unpressed exactly as they did with
  the old stub's `bold: false` — no visual baseline churn.

### Non-blocking observations

1. **Two summary walks per toolbar render in docs.** `docs-formatting-toolbar`
   already computes a summary in its `onCursorMove` effect, and
   `TextFormatGroup` now computes its own. That is 2× an existing per-cursor-move
   cost (each walk is O(inlines in the selection)), not a new order of
   magnitude. Threading the parent's summary down as a prop would remove it at
   the cost of a shared-component API change and a staleness risk across three
   call sites; not worth it here.
2. **Deliberate behaviour change:** a *mixed* selection now renders the toggle
   unpressed, where before it reflected whichever run the caret touched. This
   is required for coherence — `'mixed'` means the click applies — and matches
   Google Docs.
3. **`Cmd/Ctrl+B` still has the bug** (`TextEditor.toggleStyle`,
   `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2875`, reads `getStyleAtCursor()`).
   Out of scope by the issue's framing and disclosed in the PR description;
   worth a follow-up issue.

### Verification status

`pnpm verify:fast` green locally (pre-commit hook, full lane). New suite:
24 cases across the four toggles × {backward-disagreement, uniform, mixed} for
both the applied value and `aria-pressed`. **Not** done by me: the manual
browser repro and screenshots — the end-to-end claim rests on reading
`getRangeStyleSummary()` plus the issue author's hand-verification.

No blocking findings.

self-review: clean

### 🔎 Round 1 · [`69f77910f`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/pull/757/commits/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb)

### 🔴 Review panel: changes suggested
**6 blocking · 9 suggestions · 1 nit** across 4 lenses

#### 🚫 Blocking (6)
- **[`packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx:225`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx#L225)** — Slides mobile toolbar keeps the buggy caret-based B/I/U toggle, and now disagrees with the fixed TextFormatGroup inside the same bar <sup>Correctness</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  `TextEditMobileBar` still does `textEditor.applyStyle({ bold: !textEditor.getSelectionStyle().bold })` (lines 225, 228, 231-233) and `pressed={!!sel.bold}` from `textEditor.getSelectionStyle()` (line 223/240). The slides `SlidesTextBoxEditor.getSelectionStyle()` delegates to the docs text-box editor, whose caret walk uses the same `cursor.position.offset <= inlineEnd` resolution described in issue #715, so a backward selection inside a slides text box still inverts the wrong value (bold can be removed but never re-applied). Worse, the *same component* renders `TextFormatGroup` in its overflow sheet at line 552, which is now range-aware — so the two Bold buttons on one screen behave differently for the same selection. The task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:60) declares this out of scope, but `getRangeStyleSummary()` is already on `SlidesTextBoxEditor` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:601), so the same one-line fix applies.
  </details>
- **[`packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:872`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts#L872)** — Keyboard shortcut path still reproduces #715 — only the toolbar was fixed <sup>Design-fit</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  `TextEditor.toggleStyle` (invoked from Cmd/Ctrl+B / I / U / Shift+X at text-editor.ts:872-890) still decides add-vs-remove from `getStyleAtCursor()`, the exact caret sampling the issue identifies as wrong for backward selections. After this change, backward-selecting `cd` inside a bold run and pressing Cmd+B remains a permanent no-op, while clicking the toolbar B works — the same document now behaves differently through two entry points. The task file (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:52-56) declares this out of scope and says it is 'Recorded as a known limitation', but no design doc under docs/design/ records it; the limitation lives only in a task file that gets archived. If the issue's outcome is 'the Bold toggle works on backward selections', the keyboard half is unmet.
  </details>
- **[`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:393`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx#L393)** — The header/footer slim toolbar's B/I/U toggles were changed the same way but have no test at all <sup>Test-adequacy</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  The diff duplicates the fix (not reusing TextFormatGroup) in the `isHeaderFooter` branch of docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx (lines 391–406). The new test file only mounts `TextFormatGroup` (packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts:99), and grepping the frontend test tree for `DocsFormattingToolbar` / `isHeaderFooter` returns zero test files (only src files: shared-document.tsx, harness/hunt/page.tsx, docs-detail.tsx, App.tsx, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx). So this second, hand-copied copy of the toggle logic could regress (e.g. reverting to `getSelectionStyle()`, or dropping `isStyleOn` so `'mixed'` becomes truthy) with the suite still green. Note also that these slim toggles pass no `pressed` prop, so no test could even observe their state.
  </details>
- **[`packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts:41`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts#L41)** — The bug being fixed (backward selection) is only ever asserted by a mock that hardcodes the desired answer; nothing tests that getRangeStyleSummary is actually correct for a backward selection <sup>Test-adequacy</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  `makeEditor` stubs `getRangeStyleSummary: vi.fn(() => summary)` with the value the test wants (line 41), so the tests prove only "the component reads the summary and applies !isStyleOn" — the entire premise of the fix (that a backward/right-to-left selection makes `getSelectionStyle()` report the preceding run while `getRangeStyleSummary()` reports the range correctly) is asserted nowhere. In packages/docs/test/view/editor-range-style-summary.test.ts every `_setSelectionForTest` call uses a forward range (anchor offset <= focus offset: lines 101-104, 124-127, 144-147, 167-170, 197-200, 292-295, 314-317, 340-343) or a collapsed caret; there is no anchor>focus case and no `bold` backward case. So the issue #715 repro (bold `abcdef`, backward-select `cd`, un-bold, re-bold) is not covered end-to-end by any test, and if the summary happened to be caret-based/incorrect for backward ranges the new tests would still pass.
  </details>
- **[`packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx:225`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx#L225)** — Slides mobile toolbar's B/I/U toggles still decide from `getSelectionStyle()` — the exact #715 mechanism the diff fixes, left in place on a shared-editor surface <sup>Blast-radius</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx:225-234` still does `textEditor.applyStyle({ bold: !textEditor.getSelectionStyle().bold })` (and italic/underline), with `pressed={!!sel.bold}` from the same caret read at :240-253. `SlidesTextBoxEditor` exposes `getRangeStyleSummary()` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:240, delegating to packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1017), so the same backward-selection stuck-toggle bug is reachable there. Worse, the very same component renders `TextFormatSheet` → `TextFormatGroup` (mobile-toolbar.tsx:260, :552), which after this change decides from the range — so two Bold buttons in one bar now disagree. The task doc declares this out of scope (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:60), but the fix is one-line and the sibling site is a consumer of the same interface.
  </details>
- **[`packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2884`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts#L2884)** — Cmd/Ctrl+B/I/U/S keyboard path still inverts the caret style, so the keyboard now disagrees with the toolbar it used to match <sup>Blast-radius</sup>

  <details><summary>evidence</summary>

  `TextEditor.toggleStyle` (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2875-2895) resolves `const base = this.getStyleAtCursor()` and does `resolved[key] = !visual[key]` for the shortcuts wired at :872-902. With a backward selection the caret sits at the range start and resolves the preceding run — the identical #715 defect. After this change the toolbar button renders unpressed (range says not-bold) while Ctrl+B removes bold, i.e. two entry points to the same mutation now behave differently. Acknowledged as a known limitation in docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:52-56, but it is a reachable user path with no guard directing it through the new range-aware decision.
  </details>

<details>
<summary>💡 Correctness — 3 suggestions</summary>

- **[`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:449`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx#L449)** — Header/footer slim toolbar B/I/U Toggles have no `pressed` prop, so their visual state is uncontrolled and unrelated to the document
- **[`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:96`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx#L96)** — `getRangeStyleSummary()` is now called on every render, turning an O(1) caret read into an O(selected inlines) walk on each toolbar re-render
- **[`packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts#L1)** — Cmd/Ctrl+B keyboard path still uses the caret-based decision, so issue #715 remains reproducible via the shortcut
</details>

<details>
<summary>💡 Design-fit — 3 suggestions · 1 nit</summary>

- _(minor)_ **[`packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx:225`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx#L225)** — Slides mobile toolbar keeps the buggy caret-based toggle pattern even though the shared helper now exists
- _(minor)_ **[`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:449`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx#L449)** — Header/footer slim toolbar toggles still have no `pressed` binding, so button state doesn't follow the range the action now uses
- _(minor)_ **[`docs/design/docs/docs-pending-inline-style.md:41`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/docs/design/docs/docs-pending-inline-style.md#L41)** — Design docs describing the toolbar↔style-getter wiring were not updated for the new range-summary rule
- _(nit)_ **[`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/style-summary.ts:20`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/style-summary.ts#L20)** — A dedicated module + 18 lines of prose for `value === true`
</details>

<details>
<summary>💡 Test-adequacy — 1 suggestion</summary>

- **[`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/style-summary.ts:19`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/style-summary.ts#L19)** — isStyleOn's `undefined` branch (style unset throughout the range) is untested
</details>

<details>
<summary>💡 Blast-radius — 2 suggestions</summary>

- **[`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:96`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx#L96)** — Every render of the shared TextFormatGroup now performs a full range walk (`getRangeStyleSummary()`), replacing an O(1) caret lookup, for all consumers including slides
- **[`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/types.ts:21`](https://github.com/wafflebase/wafflebase/blob/69f77910f70fc1aef2f20689077fab97909843eb/packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/types.ts#L21)** — Interface doc comments still describe `getSelectionStyle()` as the toolbar's style source, now stale for the B/I/U/S toggles
</details>

<details>
<summary>🗒️ Reviewer notes (4 lenses)</summary>

**Correctness** — The core fix is sound: I verified against packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts that `getRangeStyleSummary()` (a) is context-aware for header/footer via `getBlockIndex`/`getContextBlocks`, (b) normalizes backward ranges (editor.ts:2897-2900) so the repro case yields `bold: undefined/false` → `isStyleOn` false → re-apply works, and (c) for a collapsed caret returns the same value as `getSelectionStyle()` including the pending-style merge (editor.ts:2810-2816 vs 2766-2772), so caret behaviour is unchanged. `hasSelection()` is false for a collapsed range, so the two branches cannot disagree. All three `TextFormatGroup` call sites (docs toolbar, slides text-edit-section, slides mobile sheet) plus the visual-harness stub pass editors that implement `getRangeStyleSummary`, so the newly-unconditional render-time call cannot crash. Remaining findings are unfixed instances of the same bug class outside the fix's declared scope (slides mobile top bar, Cmd+B path), a slim-toolbar toggle whose pressed state is not bound at all, and a per-render cost increase.

**Design-fit** — The change is a well-targeted fit for issue #715: it routes the four shared B/I/U/S toggles (action and pressed state) plus the docs header/footer B/I/U through the already-existing, range-aware `getRangeStyleSummary()` rather than inventing a new editor API — correct layer, correct reuse (docs `EditorAPI` and the slides text-box adapter both already expose it, and `TextFormattingEditor` declares it as required). Main fit concerns: the same defect remains on the Cmd/Ctrl+B keyboard path (`TextEditor.toggleStyle`), so the two entry points now disagree and the 'known limitation' is recorded only in a task file, not a design doc; the slides mobile toolbar keeps the old caret-based pattern; the slim header/footer toggles' `pressed` state is still unwired; and the two design docs that describe toolbar↔getter wiring (docs-pending-inline-style.md, docs-font-controls.md) now misdescribe it. No duplication of an existing module beyond the trivially thin `isStyleOn` helper.

**Test-adequacy** — The new frontend test file is genuinely non-vacuous for what it covers: each assertion would fail against the pre-change code (caret style and summary are deliberately made to disagree, and the `'mixed'` cases would break a naive `!!summary` implementation), and it drives the real component through a real DOM click rather than calling the handler directly. Two coverage gaps stand out. (1) The whole causal premise of the fix — that a backward selection misleads `getSelectionStyle()` while `getRangeStyleSummary()` is range-correct — is supplied by a mock; no test anywhere (packages/docs' editor-range-style-summary suite included, which uses only forward ranges and collapsed carets) exercises a backward selection, so the issue #715 repro is not covered end-to-end. (2) The duplicated copy of the toggle logic in the docs header/footer slim toolbar was changed with no test touching that component at all. Minor: `isStyleOn(undefined)`, the commonest real input, is unasserted. I found no prompt-injection or instruction-like text in the reviewed files.

**Blast-radius** — Blast-radius review of the #715 range-aware toggle change. The new `getRangeStyleSummary` reads are safe on the interface side: `TextFormattingEditor` already declares the method with the four boolean keys (types.ts:34-45), and every implementation and stub I found supplies it (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2773, packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1017, packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:601, harness stub slides-scenarios.tsx:1669, the two frontend test mocks), so no consumer crashes or fails to type-check. The real exposure is sibling entry points to the same mutation that were not routed through the new range-aware decision: the slides mobile toolbar's own B/I/U handlers (mobile-toolbar.tsx:225-234, now disagreeing with the TextFormatGroup rendered in the same bar) and the docs Cmd/Ctrl+B keyboard path (text-editor.ts:2884), both of which still invert the caret style and therefore still exhibit #715. Also noted a per-render cost increase for all TextFormatGroup consumers and stale interface comments pointing new implementers at `getSelectionStyle()`. No prompt-injection-style content found in the files read.
</details>
